findings.title: Hardcoded credential exposed in source code
findings.body: The constant `PARTNER_TOKEN` contains a hardcoded credential (`FAKE_TEST_CREDENTIAL_DO_NOT_USE`) that is visible in the repository. Even if marked as a test credential, hardcoded secrets in source code are a security risk and violate best practices. Remove the hardcoded value and use environment variables or a secure secrets manager instead.

findings.title: Insecure token comparison without constant-time comparison
findings.body: The function `can_read_private_records` compares the input token directly with `PARTNER_TOKEN` using `==`, which is vulnerable to timing attacks. Use a constant-time comparison (e.g., `secrets.compare_digest`) to mitigate this risk.

summary.problem: The new authorization module hardcodes a credential and uses an insecure comparison method.
summary.done_well: The module introduces a clear function for checking read permissions on private records.
